title: Akedah letter grid: ש circled, blue letters and “hashem — The Name”
summary: The Genesis 22:15-16 letter grid with the ש in the boxed row circled in red and several nearby letters (ה, ש, ם, מ, ה) picked out; at right a diagram labelled “hashem” shows the letters מ ם above a boxed ש above the colour-coded letters of the divine name, with arrows pointing to its outer letters and the caption “The Name”.

letters.meaning: circled letter in the boxed row

pictures.description: A block of black Hebrew letters (Genesis 22:15-16 in rows) with one row boxed in green and a red circle around the blue shin (ש) in it; a few letters above and below the circled shin (ה, ש, ם, מ and a ה in the divine name) are drawn bold or in blue.

Right-hand diagram in blue, black, red and orange: the title “hashem”, letters ם and מ, a green box holding ש, and the four letters י ה ו ה underlined in red and orange, with two blue arrows pointing at the first and last letters and the caption “The Name”.

uncertain: The slide does not spell out what the highlighted letters form; the letters ה-ש-ם appear to read down the grid as hashem
Grid contents were not transcribed cell by cell
